name: Royal Carillon School "Jef Denyn"
scope: Het Schipke, the 1772 corner house at Frederik de Merodestraat 63 used by the Royal Carillon School from 1947 to 2011 and subsequently restored as a museum café.
era: Standing Rococo exterior of the former carillon school.

originalReview.notes: Tiffany Ng’s exact 2005 photograph already published on Qualla. The first account upload and Commons transfer document author and public-domain release. It shows the corner doorway and lit five-bay wing. The removal platform and temporary street equipment are outside scope.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with Tiffany Ng’s own-work public-domain original already published on Qualla. The protected building outline and Dutch-language heritage inventory resolve the former school location.
